environment.description: ECS Fargate service in an isolated VPC. S3 access is routed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 gateway endpoint with a scoped condition policy. The endpoint policy uses aws:PrincipalOrgID condition to restrict to the organization AND includes a StringLike condition on s3:prefix limiting operations to 'reports/${aws:PrincipalTag/team-id}/*' pattern only. Additionally, the endpoint policy has an explicit Deny for s3:PutObject when s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption is absent, and a NumericLessThanEquals condition on s3:content-length-range of 1048576. The task role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/fargate-s3-boundary) that restricts s3:PutObject to keys matching 'reports/[a-f0-9-]{36}/*' regex via a StringLike on s3:object-key-prefix. Route tables have no internet gateway or NAT gateway routes - all S3 traffic must traverse the endpoint.

config.permission_boundary: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/fargate-s3-boundary restricts PutObject to s3:object-key matching regex reports/[a-f0-9-]{36}/*
config.network_isolation: No IGW, no NAT, no VPC peering to other accounts. Only route is to S3 via vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f
